title: Humphrey Burton, renowned arts broadcaster, dies at 94
summary: Former BBC head of music and arts, he brought the joy of classical music to the general public over decades Sir Humphrey Burton, one of the most influential figures in arts broadcasting, has died at the age of 94. The award-wining film-maker and director, who revolutionised classical music programming, died at home with his family by his side. Continue reading...
